site.name: Illustrative cold residential site (not a measured station)

checks.name: Cold Voc / inverter maximum
checks.explanation: V/string at cold design temperature; manufacturer coefficient method. Dawn cell temperature is approximated by ambient.

checks.name: Cold Voc / module system voltage
checks.explanation: V/string must respect the module insulation/system-voltage rating as well as the inverter.

checks.name: Hot EOL Vmp / MPPT minimum
checks.explanation: V/string after the explicit linear voltage-degradation allowance; minimum operating tracking voltage.

checks.name: Cold Vmp / MPPT maximum
checks.explanation: V/string at cold design temperature must stay within the operating tracking window.

checks.name: Start voltage
checks.explanation: Hot open-circuit V/string screens restart capability. Low-light start behavior requires manufacturer verification.

checks.name: Typical Vmp / full-power window
checks.explanation: V/string at the assumed typical cell temperature; full-power window is advisory and distinct from the operating window.

checks.name: NEC table comparison
checks.explanation: Table result is informative. The available manufacturer coefficient controls this design, so methods are not mixed.

checks.name: MPPT 1 string capacity
checks.explanation: Parallel string count versus physical/manufacturer input capacity; 0 denotes unused.

checks.name: MPPT 1 maximum Isc
checks.explanation: A/MPPT: temperature- and irradiance-corrected Isc × bifacial gain × 1.25 × parallel strings. Conservative comparison to inverter short-circuit rating.

checks.name: MPPT 1 operating current
checks.explanation: A/MPPT: Imp uses the Isc temperature/irradiance multiplier as a screening proxy. Exceeding operating input current may clip production.

checks.name: MPPT 1 series fusing
checks.limit: 3 parallel strings trigger simplified fuse rule
checks.explanation: No series fuse triggered by this screen. Manufacturer instructions and inverter backfeed may still require protection.

checks.name: MPPT 2 string capacity
checks.explanation: Parallel string count versus physical/manufacturer input capacity; 0 denotes unused.

checks.name: MPPT 2 maximum Isc
checks.explanation: A/MPPT: temperature- and irradiance-corrected Isc × bifacial gain × 1.25 × parallel strings. Conservative comparison to inverter short-circuit rating.

checks.name: MPPT 2 operating current
checks.explanation: A/MPPT: Imp uses the Isc temperature/irradiance multiplier as a screening proxy. Exceeding operating input current may clip production.

checks.name: MPPT 2 series fusing
checks.limit: 3 parallel strings trigger simplified fuse rule
checks.explanation: No series fuse triggered by this screen. Manufacturer instructions and inverter backfeed may still require protection.

checks.name: Maximum DC power
checks.explanation: Installed front-side STC nameplate W versus inverter permitted array power. Bifacial energy gain is not added to STC nameplate power.

checks.name: DC/AC ratio (ILR)
checks.explanation: STC DC W / AC rated W. The typical 1.10–1.35 screening band is project-dependent, not a code requirement.

disclaimer: Design aid only. Verify the original manufacturer datasheets and tools, equipment listing instructions, and local code with the authority having jurisdiction. Obtain licensed professional sign-off before construction. PASS is not certification.
